ValidationRule.description: Allows users to only edit New status tickets.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Status__c),"Fixed/Completed"), NOT(OR($Profile.Name = "Eligibility Worker", $Profile.Name = "Fiscal Worker", $Profile.Name = "Provider Worker", $Profile.Name = "Universal User", $Profile.Name = "Read Only User", $Profile.Name = "Eligibility Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name = "Fiscal Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name = "Provider Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", $Profile.Name = "System Admin", $Profile.Name = "CHATS System Administrator", $Profile.Name = "Business Office Worker", $Profile.Name = "Business Office Supervisor", $Profile.Name = "State IT User", $Profile.Name = "State Program Administrator", $Profile.Name = "CCCAP Program Internal Team" )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot Edit a Fixed/Completed Support Ticket.
